title: Restart Kickoff Chase Hard (Chas McIvor)
style: country swing bluegrass banjo brass bongo fast beat 134bpm comedy dad voice spoken interjections southern drawl steel guitar mandolin
lyrics:
[Intro - Chas spoken]
I say son, the kickoff is a contest for the ball
Kick high, hang in the air, chase hard
Win it back at the ten metre line

[Verse 1]
The kicker drops the ball off the tee
Drop kick high, ten to fifteen metres key
Hang time four seconds in the air
The chasers sprint, the ball must be there

[Pre-Chorus]
Aim for the ten metre line, twenty metres in
Five forwards charge in a line, the win
First chaser jumps for the ball at peak
Second chaser supports for the leak

[Chorus]
Restart kickoff chase hard, son
High ball, four second hang, work begun
Five forwards in a line, sprint flat
Win the ball back, son, no chat

[Verse 2]
If you cant win the ball, force the catch in trouble
Land the ball deep in their twenty two double
Drive them back, set the pressure on the field
Kickoffs win games when you yield the wield

[Bridge - Chas spoken]
I say boy, the twenty two restart same rules
Drop kick high, four second hang the tools
Chase line of five forwards flat
Contest the ball, son, every restart that

[Chorus]
Restart kickoff chase hard, son
High ball, four second hang, work begun
Five forwards in a line, sprint flat
Win the ball back, son, no chat

[Outro]
High kick, four second hang
Five chasers, sprint with a bang
Win the contest, ball back
Thats my boy, no slack
